summary: The draft's BT-theory coverage is dense, but the datasets/platforms it measures, the influence-based method it builds on, and the manipulation/robustness framing it motivates the work with are uncited, and the draft itself says so.
missing_literatures: Chatbot Arena / MT-Bench pairwise LLM evaluation and the datasets used
influence functions and leave-one-out / Cook's-distance-style deletion diagnostics for (logistic) regression
manipulation and rigging of crowd-vote or pairwise-comparison rankings

rewrite_targets.reason: The opening claim that BT leaderboards are used to choose models and announce releases, and the Data section's use of Chatbot Arena 55k/140k and MT-Bench human judgments, carry no citation to the platform or dataset papers. A reviewer would expect these to be cited.
rewrite_targets.anchor_text: Leaderboards that aggregate ``which of A and B is better'' judgments into Bradley--Terry (BT) ratings are used to choose models
search_topics: Chatbot Arena open platform for evaluating LLMs by human preference

rewrite_targets.reason: The one-step Newton influence formula with leave-one-out leverage correction (Eq. infl) is the core of the studied configuration and the decisive B2 comparator, yet it is presented without any citation to influence-function or deletion-diagnostic literature. Only Broderick et al. is cited for data dropping.
rewrite_targets.anchor_text: Deleting row $i$ perturbs the stationarity condition by $-\nabla\ell_i$, so a Newton step predicts the change of the gap
search_topics: influence functions for understanding black-box predictions
Cook's distance case deletion influence logistic regression

rewrite_targets.reason: The 'Scope of the bibliography' paragraph and Extended limitations explicitly concede that work on adversarial manipulation of crowd-vote leaderboards is relevant but uncited, and the Introduction and Discussion motivate the budget through 'deliberate action' and rigging. One or two papers would let the paper position itself instead of disclaiming.
rewrite_targets.anchor_text: Work on adversarial manipulation of crowd-vote leaderboards, on evaluation practices of arena-style platforms, and on influence functions
